Research and innovation

UCT’s Vision 2030 commits us to ‘unleashing knowledge in and from Africa to redefine and co-create a sustainable global future’. We strive to address global challenges and realise new opportunities in the social and natural worlds.

15

We're ranked 15th in the world for Development Studies by QS World University Rankings by Subject 2025

28

We're ranked 28th in the world for infectious diseases by US News Best Global Universities rankings 2025–2026

40

We're ranked 40th in the world by Quacquarelli Symonds World University Rankings: Sustainability 2025

50

We're ranked 50th in the world for Public, Environmental & Occupational Health in the US News & World Report Best Global Universities Rankings for Subjects 2025-2026

Leading researchers

UCT’s cutting-edge research is led by world-renowned academics whose work is focused on building new fundamental knowledge for the future while responding to the world’s most pressing challenges in the present.
11 Jun 2024

Global research partnerships

UCT is affiliated with local and international strategic research networks and partnerships that have, and continue to, position us as a premier academic meeting point between South Africa, the rest of Africa and the world.
11 Jun 2024

Strategic research strengths

UCT is committed to advancing Africa's developmental agenda and contributing to global science. Our research focuses on our unique areas of expertise and strengths selected to deliver transformative impact.
11 Jun 2024

Rankings

UCT’s position as the highest-ranked university in Africa in five major world university rankings has contributed to its strong global reputation.
11 Jun 2024

UCT and the UN Sustainable Development Goals

UCT is leading transdisciplinary research and multilateral collaboration to create sustainable and equitable development in Africa.
11 Jun 2024

Publications

UCT’s publications showcase our strategic focus and the impact of our latest breakthrough research that is advancing local and global science.
